name: Galaxy Nexus

images.credit: WilliamTheaker, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM/GPRS/EDGE (telecommunication), EDGE 850/900/1800/1900, High Speed Packet Access, HSPA 850/900/1700/1900/2100, High-Speed Downlink Packet Access, HSDPA 21 Mbit/s, High-Speed Uplink Packet Access, HSUPA 5.76 Mbit/s, 3GPP Long Term Evolution, LTE + CDMA2000 EV-DO Rev.A (Verizon, Sprint)

Body.Dimensions: Height: 135.5 mm, Width: 67.94 mm, Depth: 8.94 mm or 9.47 mm for the 3GPP Long Term Evolution, LTE variant
Body.Other: Wi-Fi hotspot, Wi-Fi Direct, USB tethering, Oleophobic display coating

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 4.0.1 "Ice Cream Sandwich", Last: Android 4.3 "Jelly Bean" (4.2 for Verizon's Toro variant)

Display.Display: 4.65 in diagonal HD Super AMOLED with RGBG-Matrix (PenTile), 1280×720 px *(316 ppi), 16:9 aspect-ratio, 10 μs response time

Cameras.Rear camera: 5 MP (2592×1936 px), Autofocus, zero shutter lag, single LED flash, 1080p video recording, (1920×1080 @ 24 fps)
Cameras.Front camera: 1.3 MP, 720p video, (1280×720 @ 30 fps), Video: MP4, H.264, H.263, WebM

Battery.Battery: 1,750 mAh (HSPA+ version) , 1,850 mAh (LTE version), internal user-replaceable , 2,000 mAh (Official extended battery. Korean variants includes both 1,750 mAh and 2,000 mAh batteries), 2,100 mAh (Sprint/Verizon Extended Battery. Wider than the GSM model)., rechargeable Li-ion

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm TRRS, GPS, DLNA, Micro USB 2.0 with USB On-The-Go, MHL, Bluetooth 3.0, NFC, Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n (2.4/5 GHz)
